audit.whatIsWrong: Three chart rows contradicted the prose sitting beside them: win[3]/phases[3] said Garen while whys[3] opens 'Even lane'; win[5]/phases[5] said Garen while whys[5] opens 'Skill window'; win[4]/phases[4] said Skill while whys[4] and spikes[2] both say Maokai owns level 6.
audit.why: The packet chart (Garen/Garen/Garen/Skill/Maokai/Skill/Maokai) already matches every why on the page — the tokens were simply never brought onto it, and the mirror audit flipped its level-6 row for the same reason.
audit.corrected: Chart set to Garen / Garen / Garen / Skill / Maokai / Skill / Maokai as one atomic group with matched full+content pairs; ratings raised on the three rows that moved. No prose needed changing to support it.

audit.whatIsWrong: Level 6 was written as a generic 'reassess every all-in' line that gave Garen's ultimate no numbers.
audit.why: Demacian Justice is 400 range and true damage on 120/100/80 — the point is that it needs him standing next to you, which a root prevents entirely.
audit.corrected: phases[4].why rewritten to state the 400 range and that a rooted Garen never reaches it.
sources: enemyKit R: range 400, cd 120/100/80, trueDamage, execute

audit.whatIsWrong: The page names Courage as the tracked cooldown everywhere and never says what Decisive Strike actually does beyond 'silence'. Riot's text: it 'gains a burst of Move Speed, breaking free of all slows affecting him'. Maokai's Q is a knockback plus slow — Garen deletes the slow half of it for free, every 8 seconds, at zero mana.
audit.why: It is the best unstated advantage Garen has here and it changes what Q is for: a knockback to create space, not a slow to hold him. The mirror audit found the same thing from the other side and had no in-band field to carry it.
audit.corrected: Written into breakdown.cooldowns, whys[1], phases[0].why and phases[1].why with the 8s / zero-cost figures.
sources: enemyKit Q text and cd 8, cost 0

audit.whatIsWrong: Nothing said how to shut off Perseverance.
audit.why: Riot's text: he regenerates only 'if Garen has not recently been struck by damage or enemy abilities'. A sapling parked on him (E, 1100 range, 18s at rank 1) keeps damage ticking and turns his out-of-combat reset off — that is the concrete counter to the 'let him reset with regen' mistake the page already warns about but never explains.
audit.corrected: Written into wants.you[1], phases[3].why and tradeGood.

audit.whatIsWrong: Courage was described only as 'damage reduction'.
audit.why: It also grants tenacity, so it shortens Maokai's root as well as cutting the damage, and it is 22s at rank 1 — a long, real window.

edits.before: Passive heal + AA trades carry the early waves. Identify how Garen contests the first waves before you commit anything.
edits.after: Decisive Strike costs nothing and silences you on an 8s cooldown. With one ability you cannot answer it — last-hit and concede.

edits.before: W root is your engage AND your peel — spend it once per fight. Only take the trade when Garen's Courage is down.
edits.after: His Q is free and up every 8s, so he can silence every step-up. Wait for him to spend it on the wave before your W goes in.

edits.before: Full kit online — your core pattern starts now. Keep the wave near your side so Garen must walk into your engage range.
edits.after: Courage is 22s at rank 1 and grants tenacity, so it shortens your root as well as cutting damage. Trade only once it is spent.

edits.before: The lane-control window: trade around Courage's cooldown and bank small leads. If ahead, freeze and deny; if behind, farm safe.
edits.after: Even now: your W-Q with Sap Magic matches his Q strike. Keep a sapling on him — his regen only ticks when nothing has hit him.

edits.before: Nature’s Grasp roots whole teams — lane it only for kill windows. Reassess every all-in at 6 — Garen's ultimate changes the math too.
edits.after: Level 6 is yours: Demacian Justice is 400-range true damage, and a rooted Garen never closes to it. Root first and the execute dies.

edits.before: - Garen Courage: matchup-defining — Damage reduction. Trade when down. Track it before every engage. - Your committal tool: never spend it on chip. - Your ultimate: the win condition — kill windows only.
edits.after: - Garen Decisive Strike: matchup-defining — free silence every 8s, and it breaks your Q slow outright. Step up only after he spends it. - Courage: 22s at rank 1, tenacity plus damage cut — do not open into it.

edits.before: W-root Garen the moment his answer is down, Q-knockback the follow-up, and let brush saplings tax his every path.
edits.after: W-root him the moment Courage is spent — Twisted Advance can't be dodged — then Q him back and let a sapling deny his regen.

edits.before: He still edges level 2 — his Q empowered strike plus silence beats my trade before my W-into-Q root is fully online.
edits.after: He still edges 2 — Decisive Strike breaks every slow, so my Q knockback buys no chase time and his silence beats my step-up.

edits.before: Proc Sap Magic on the trade so you heal back the chip from his Q-empowered strike
edits.after: Keep E (Sapling Toss) on him — Perseverance only regenerates while nothing has hit him

notes: The chart fix here needed no prose rewrites at all — the whys already described the packet chart and only the tokens were stale, which is worth noting because it is the cheapest kind of defect on this champion and there may be more of it. Maokai's Q carries a 'grounding' derived flag that Riot's Bramble Smash text does not support (knockback, damage, slow only); I wrote no grounding claim. Garen's W tenacity shortening the root is stated as tenacity from Riot's own text, not as a specific duration, since no number is available.
